review_findings_resolved_in_code.finding: ENGINE summary had literal counts/PASS fields without raw/checkpoint evidence coverage
review_findings_resolved_in_code.resolution: Now derives 1536 successful trace slots and 8 updates, rechecks raw IDs/seeds/config/logprobs/text/rewards/advantages, exact token path, all step0-4 checkpoint/metrics identities and bound evidence file hashes; total physical cost includes interruptions separately.

review_findings_resolved_in_code.resolution: Callback persists TECHNICAL_INVALID raw with actual values and error information before raising; collector prohibits reuse.

review_findings_resolved_in_code.resolution: Collector checks actual seed/config/qid, preserves mismatching actual values plus expected_identity, saves invalid evidence and rejects it.

review_findings_resolved_in_code.finding: Standalone stress entry accepted status-only natural comparison
review_findings_resolved_in_code.resolution: Stress and comparison reuse verify current freeze, fixed trace sizes, artifact hashes and all natural constant/zero-policy diagnostics before loading the model.

review_findings_resolved_in_code.finding: Batch-only USR1 signal reached ENGINE parent but not child
review_findings_resolved_in_code.resolution: Parent signal handling covers initialization and uses Popen forwarding to the current child; durable checkpoint anchors and resumable exit handling preserve lease recovery.

review_findings_resolved_in_code.finding: COMMON adapter write could leave an uncommitted partial final directory
review_findings_resolved_in_code.resolution: Staging plus atomic rename; an existing uncommitted adapter is accepted only when fixed initialization file hashes match, without overwriting it.

One visible actual RTX PRO 6000 is verified and recorded with UUID/name/memory/compute capability/driver/PCI/hostname; changed-hardware unfinished comparison tracks are preserved and paired traces rerun under identical registered seeds/recipe.

remaining_acceptance_boundaries: Actual Qwen3.5-9B BF16/FP32 native visual ENGINE and registered probability tolerances are untested by this reviewer at this point.

Future real ENGINE needs three actual fresh process identities and independent CPU tensor/NumPy equality on its own trusted checkpoint files; hashes and tiny CPU fixtures do not substitute for that evidence.

generated_tokens post-callback ledger can be a lower bound across crash boundaries; final known generated token totals must be independently recounted from every retained raw record, with unknown inflight attempts kept separately and never refunded.
All 34 scientific paths, 5 probes and 35 endpoint identities remain required before scientific analysis/release; this code review authorizes no additional arms or research stage.
code_changes_by_reviewer: Only previously delegated common.py allocation functions and associated tests. The runtime/training/ENGINE fixes were implemented by their owning worker. No commit/push by reviewer; parent integrates.
